jobs.title: HR & People Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT AMPEROS

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.






ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an HR & People Operations Lead to build and run the people function for our India team. Today our associates, team leads, QA specialists, and managers across the globe are supported by a mix of US leadership and a lot of goodwill. That has worked while we were small, but now we are ready to scale.

This is a ground-up role. You'll own recruiting coordination, offers, onboarding, documentation, compliance, and payroll administration, and you'll build the employee experience layer we don't have yet: structured onboarding, regular engagement touch points, clear leave and conduct policies, and a feedback channel that surfaces problems before they become attrition. You'll be the first person in India that employees go to with an HR question, and the person US leadership relies on to know how the team is actually doing. You'll work closely with our RCM Operations leaders and our People lead in the US.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Recruiting & offers
   
   - Partner with hiring managers to define roles and coordinate sourcing, screening, and interview scheduling 
   
   - Run background checks, prepare and send offer letters, and handle candidate negotiations within approved bands
   
   - Track pipeline and hiring tickets and keep hiring documentation complete

 - Onboarding
   
   - Own the end-to-end new hire experience from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, and make sure no one starts without access, equipment, or a clear plan
   
   - Coordinate access provisioning and confirm HIPAA, data security, and acceptable use training is complete
   
   - Collect and maintain employee documentation and build records in our platform
   
   - Run structured 30/60/90 day check-ins with new hires and route what you hear to their manager

 - Employee engagement
   
   - Build and run a regular engagement cadence: pulse checks, skip-levels, stay conversations, and exit interviews, and report themes to leadership
   
   - Own the employee side of India holidays, leave, attendance, and coverage, including the policies behind them (public holiday pay, disaster and unforeseen absence, equipment outage)
   
   - Draft and roll out the people policies we're missing: leave, appraisal and salary bands, behavioral and conduct, and keep them applied consistently across teams
   
   - Support managers on documentation, performance conversations, and corrective action so feedback is written down and follows a clear escalation path

 - Payroll & compliance
   
   - Administer monthly payroll, resolve discrepancies and adjustments, and process offboardings and full and final settlements
   
   - Maintain working knowledge of Indian labour law (Shops and Establishments Act, EPF, ESI, income tax) and keep us ahead of statutory deadlines
   
   - Keep all employee and payroll data confidential, organized, and audit-ready
     
      


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience
   
   - 3 to 5 years in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles supporting an India-based team, with hands-on payroll and onboarding experience
   
   - Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (EPF, ESI, tax withholding, Shops and Establishments Act)
   
   - Experience building HR processes or policies where none existed, not just administering mature ones

 - Skills and attributes
   
   - Comfortable being the person employees come to, and comfortable telling a manager something they don't want to hear
   
   - Strong attention to detail with numerical and compliance data; nothing slips
   
   - Clear written and verbal communication in English; able to handle sensitive conversations with discretion
   
   - Proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms (Deel strongly preferred), Excel/Sheets, and documentation tools (Notion, Google Drive, Linear)
   
   - Able to overlap with US Eastern hours for part of the day

 - Nice-to-Haves
   
   - Experience supporting a remote or distributed team managed from the US
   
   - Background in healthcare, RCM, or BPO/KPO operations
   
   - Experience with Ashby, Checkr, or similar recruiting and screening tools
   
   - Experience running engagement surveys or building an onboarding program from scratch
    
    




OUR VALUES

 - Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

 - Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

 - Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.
